transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

...Hi. Um, well... I guess I've just been having a hard time lately. I work as a host at a restaurant, and... I don't know, it's hard to explain. 

I just... I can't stop thinking about how my hairline and my face look. Especially under those restaurant lights. It just makes me look really old and... strange. My coworkers tell me they don't see what I'm talking about, but... yeah. That's basically why I'm here.
How much do these concerns about your hairline and face bother you when you're not at work or in those restaurant lights?
Um... I guess... it's not just the restaurant. It's... I don't really know. It's pretty much always there. Even when I'm at home, I just... I can't really turn it off. It doesn't really go away.
When you think about how you look, do you worry about other parts of your body or face besides your hairline?
Um... no. Not really. Just... what I already said. My hairline, and... my face. I don't really... I don't focus on other parts. That's... that's enough, I guess.

When you think about how your hairline and face look, do you find yourself doing things like checking mirrors often, covering up, or trying to fix it in your mind? Like repeating certain thoughts or actions to try to feel better?

Um... yeah, I guess I do. Before my shift... I spend a lot of time in the bathroom. Checking the mirror. 

I take... pictures on my phone. Just to see the angles. I try to comb my hair forward to cover it up, and... I just keep thinking about how the customers are going to see me. Sometimes I do it so much I end up being late. Or... I just get too worked up to even go out front.
How much do these concerns about your hairline and face interfere with your life, like your work, relationships, or other activities?

Um... it gets in the way a lot, I guess. 

I've... I've actually been written up at the restaurant. Because I'm late. Or... sometimes I just miss shifts completely. I just can't do it. 

And... I don't really do much else anymore. I stopped going to the staff photos. I used to go to gallery events, and... hikes, but... I don't go now. I just... I can't handle people seeing me like that. It's just too much.
